none.description:
{Deconstruction}

Runs time backwards on one enemy war machine or stack of mechanical troops and takes it apart: deals (Spell Power x 25 + 25) damage.
Has no effect on living creatures.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron god is Kronos, damage +25%.

none.description:
{Traitor}

Turns one enemy stack whose total Hit Points do not exceed (Spell Power x 25 + 10) to your side; it fights for you for a number of rounds equal to Spell Power.
Has no effect on troops immune to mind spells or on commanders.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron god is Kronos or Gaia, lasts one more round.

{Chaos}

Enemy troops on the target hex are thrown into chaos and turn on their own side until they have attacked once.
Has no effect on troops immune to mind spells or on commanders.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron god is Kronos or Oranos, lasts one more round.

basic.description:
{Basic Chaos}

Has no effect on troops immune to mind spells or on commanders.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron god is Kronos or Oranos, lasts one more round.

expert.description:

Has no effect on troops immune to mind spells or on commanders.

none.description:
{Hesperides}

Plants a golden apple tree on the target empty hex (it takes up one hex and stays for the whole battle), and Hamadryads come to guard it: their total Hit Points are Spell Power x 20 (54 Hit Points each).
All friendly living troops recover 10 Hit Points each round, for a number of rounds equal to Spell Power.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron god is Oranos or Gaia, summoned amount +25%.

none.description:
{Implode}

Pulls all troops on the target hex and the hexes around it towards one point and then blasts them apart: each takes (Spell Power x 20 + 40) damage, +10% for every additional stack caught (up to +50%).
Flying troops and giants of level 7 and above are not affected.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron god is Kronos or Gaia, damage +25%.
